name: Shemida
title: Descendant of Manasseh
summary: Shemida was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh, the son of Joseph. He was a clan leader in the tribe of Manasseh and received land when Canaan was distributed among the tribes of Israel. His descendants formed the Shemidaites clan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Shemida is listed as one of the sons of Gilead in the tribe of Manasseh, and his descendants are recorded as a distinct clan.

keyEvents.title: Land Allocation to Manasseh
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Shemida received their share of the inheritance when Joshua divided Canaan among the tribes of Israel. The male descendants received their allotted portion.

keyEvents.title: Shemida's Sons in the Books of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Shemida's sons are named: Achian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam, documenting his descendants within the tribe of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: Part of Manasseh's Western Inheritance
keyEvents.description: The Shemida clan was among the male descendants of Manasseh who received inheritances west of the Jordan, unlike those who settled east of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in Israel's Genealogical Registers
keyEvents.description: Shemida was included in the official genealogical registers as an important clan leader, confirming his descendants' rights in the promised land.
